name: Lincoln

neighborhoods.name: Witherbee
neighborhoods.homes: older homes and small apartment buildings

housing: Lincoln's rentals are a mix of apartment complexes, older houses converted to apartments near downtown and the university, and single-family homes.

localRules.text: Buildings with three or more rental units in Lincoln must be licensed under the city's Apartment Licensing Ordinance.

tenantHelp.name: Tenant Assistance Project
tenantHelp.what: free help for tenants facing eviction

tenantHelp.name: UNL Tenant Assistance Project
tenantHelp.what: law clinic representing tenants in eviction cases

climate: Test both the furnace and the air conditioning, and check windows and the roof for storm damage; Lincoln has cold winters, hot summers and hail.
fact: Lincoln's city inspections of rentals are mostly complaint-driven rather than routine.
